name: Hello WebAssembly (Rust)
description: The WebAssembly example in Rust (tome-wasm): game events, the main menu, a /hellowasmrs chat command with settings, a key (Ctrl+Shift+R), messages from hello-wasm and JASS natives.
natives: native HelloWasmRsAdd takes integer a, integer b returns integer
native HelloWasmRsHalf takes real value returns real
native HelloWasmRsGreet takes string name returns string
native HelloWasmRsSame takes unit u returns unit
